temporary.qualification: Client recruitTickets rarityList/professionList intersect actual character metadata and predefinedChars canBeFree=true,recruitType=FREE. Qualification is not an identity sampling pool.
temporary.storage: Shared actual-ticket capacity 3; open a retained ticket only at FINAL with a fresh supplied observation. Do not convert aggregate ticket history or portable unretained historical tickets.

Exact identity overlap when earlier formal roster identity was never observed

employment.price_rule: Charge supplied real displayed price; no random-price or random-identity generator.
employment.refresh_rule: Pay before accepting replacement candidates. Observation does not pay twice or reset hire count. Leaving after payment still consumes this refresh in node history. The actual active offer is consumed once.
employment.identity_rule: Separate emergency instances; not formal recruits, recruit tickets, promotions, expeditions or permanent roster counts.
employment.battle_departure: Only supplied participants of an actually completed numbered battle depart. No future battle assignment, retroactive assignment before hire, or replayed battle settlement.
unresolved: Whether refresh resets hire count; conservative current count retained
Emergency hiring triggers of corn and mastery; no such reward added
Default combat participant identities; no automatic departure assumption

rest_upgrade_correction.runtime: Give a physical all-profession upgrade ticket instead of an inert scalar supply voucher. Existing actual promotion logic consumes it once; receipt itself is not recruitment and does not grow corn.

automatic_simulation: No observed candidate inputs are fabricated. These bridges add executable real observations, not synthetic free recruits or an EMPLOY income source.
